name: SLIM
tagline: Pinpoint lunar landing; toppled but operational
description: JAXA’s 2024 lunar lander. Touched down within 100 m of its target — pinpoint accuracy unprecedented for a lunar lander — but landed on its nose at roughly 90 degrees, with solar panels facing away from the Sun. Still operated and survived four lunar nights without radioisotope heating — a record for passively-heated lunar surface missions.
best_known_for: Pinpoint lunar landing; toppled but operational
